In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection in the hotel options surfaced.

sections.headline: The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection's most important issue is concentrated competitive displacement by The Dupont Circle Hotel, not a vague visibility problem.
sections.keyInsight: The Dupont Circle Hotel appears in 15 monitored scenarios where The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection is absent. That concentration matters more than a long competitor list because it identifies a repeatable substitution pattern. Related Reality Gap pressure includes Soft Brand / Independence at 0% recognition, which may help explain why the hotel is not carried into those answers.
sections.whyItMatters: Leadership needs to understand why specific alternatives are surfaced instead of The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection in recurring demand contexts. Otherwise attention may stay on average scores while missing the concentrated leak. A displacement pattern that repeats is more actionable than a soft overall visibility narrative.
sections.focusNow: Focus first on the demand contexts where The Dupont Circle Hotel is consistently surfaced instead of The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection. Determine whether the relevant attributes and use cases are clearly represented across priority sources, and whether the hotel's own proposition is complete for those same contexts.
sections.whatToReview: Open the underlying displacement evidence for The Dupont Circle Hotel and compare attributes cited in those answers with The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection's first-party and major travel-source representation. Confirm whether the same cues appear when the hotel is present.
